note: Coverage registry rendered by client/src/pages/CoveragePage.jsx. Every figure carries the vintage it was measured at; nothing here is computed at request time.

datasets.name: OIG LEIE
datasets.provenance: Downloaded directly from the OIG exclusions database.

datasets.name: State Medicaid exclusion lists
datasets.scope: State-level Medicaid program exclusions and terminations
datasets.cadence: Varies by state; each state publishes on its own schedule
datasets.provenance: Sourced via the OpenSanctions public mirror of official state lists, not scraped from each state directly.
notes: Commercial deployments should re-extract from the official state URLs recorded per jurisdiction below, or license OpenSanctions directly. The mirror is suitable for evaluation and internal screening, not for redistribution.

datasets.name: NPPES national registry
datasets.cadence: Monthly full replacement, with weekly incrementals
datasets.provenance: Full-file load of the August 2026 V.2 dissemination file.
notes: Count includes deactivated enumerations, which is why it exceeds the number of active NPIs.

datasets.name: CMS Care Compare quality measures
datasets.scope: Hospital quality measures, cached per facility on demand
datasets.cadence: Rolling; CMS refreshes the underlying datasets on its own schedule
datasets.provenance: Fetched per facility from the CMS provider-data datastore API and cached.
notes: Coverage grows as facilities are requested; it is a cache, not a bulk load.
Each cached measure carries its own access date rather than sharing one dataset-level vintage.

datasets.name: CMS QPP MIPS (per-year archive + rolling vintage)
datasets.scope: MIPS performance scores: true per-year rows for PY 2018-2020 and 2022-2024 (bulk archive), plus a small rolling-vintage cache for the current period
datasets.cadence: Yearly archive files (Wayback-captured vintages); rolling dataset re-bases in place
datasets.provenance: tools/mips-yearly-ingest.js bulk-loads each archived yearly CSV into mips_performance_scores with performance_year taken from the dataset vintage (year_source=archive). Rolling-vintage cache rows remain labeled year_source=rolling.
notes: PY 2021 has no retrievable archive file (no Wayback capture; live URL gone) and PY 2017 predates the catalog; marked insufficient materials in docs/research/mips-yearly-sources.md.
Trends built only on archive-sourced years no longer carry the rolling-vintage warning; any rolling-vintage year keeps it.

datasets.name: State license status (TX, CO)
datasets.publisher: Texas Medical Board (data.texas.gov) and Colorado DORA (data.colorado.gov)
datasets.scope: Medical license status for Texas and Colorado, all license types
datasets.cadence: Refreshed on demand; Socrata feeds update on the states own schedules
datasets.provenance: Keyless Socrata bulk APIs, loaded by tools/license-status-ingest.js with parsed=inserted=table self-verification. TX 455,287 unique licenses, CO 1,585,738.
notes: Only Texas and Colorado publish free keyless license-status bulk; the remaining states are lookup-only per docs/research/license-source-survey.md.
